 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. It's Week 8 of the 2026 NFL season and fantasy football is almost at the mid-way point of the campaign. We have four teams on bye in Week 8 — the 49ers, Giants, Texans and Saints. That means a few elite wideouts won't be available to you as Chris Olave, Malik Nabers and Nico Collins will be out of lineups.
 Below, Yahoo analysts Justin Boone, Matt Harmon, Scott Pianowski, Joel Smyth and Hayden Winks provide their wide receiver rankings for Week 8.
